IF OBJECT_ID('sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion', 'P') IS NOT NULL DROP PROCEDURE sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion;
EXEC (' CREATE PROCEDURE sales.GetRecentFeedbackByRegion AS BEGIN SELECT TOP 10 c.CustomerID, c.TerritoryID, f.rating, f.feedback_text, f.submitted_at FROM sales.Customer c JOIN sales.customer_feedback f ON c.CustomerID = f.customer_id WHERE f.submitted_at > DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE()) ORDER BY f.submitted_at DESC; END ');
